source_provenance.fundamentally_unscanned: Earlier Git revisions, user NAS, independent private records.

algorithm.candidate_first_meaning: Ordinary classical heuristic candidate checked upfront at exactly same informational budget.
algorithm.old_misleading_comparison: Prior large relative improvement mainly came from testing a correct complete candidate immediately while baseline lacked identical candidate-first control.
algorithm.hard_limit: Bounded search n<=10, explicit 2**n UNSAT truth-table verification; not reusable as n=18 MAJ3-K4 production solver.

original_research_lanes.algorithm_transfer: Only falsification and competing hypotheses, no physical model as input to SAT.
Archive provenance is not verified physical mechanism.
Pre-freeze benchmarks, failure states, test order, no post-hoc outcome reinterpretation.
Do not invent numerical likelihood or calibration from archive.
Use causally validated event order, no future->producer edge.
Prevent duplicate jobs, stale receipts and ambiguous timestamps.
Keep invalid/unresolved apart from true null.
Preserve evidence that selected pattern did not replicate.
Backcasting/rollback are forward-time engineering; simulated future is not future truth.
Externally hidden labels with preregistered SHA and chronological integrity.
Reversible symbolic processing is not actual backward time.

next_tests: External blinded SAT/Exact-One distribution; register algorithm SHA and baseline parameters before labels released
Same-instance classic CDCL/C023 and candidate-first comparisons on larger n
Report nodes, wall, peak RSS, hint-generation time and proof replay costs separately
Permutation-invariance tests and adversarial false hints
Preserve nulls, failed trials, invalid provenance as append-only receipts
Forbid production C023 replacement until independent strict promotion gate succeeds

integrity_and_claim_ceiling.claim: A mathematical backwards-goal heuristic exists and passes bounded SAT/Exact-One controls; independent science and physical tachyon detection remain unestablished.
